status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces now hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, extending fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, and a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE also carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene kontrollerer nå korridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og en annen by i Bay-regionen, og utvider kampene i sørlige Somalia. Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandlet 148 sårede etter tung kamp i Baidoa. Etiopia har trukket tilbake mer enn 3 000 soldater og vil ikke intervenere i konflikten i South West State, og et droneram i Puntland fra De forente arabiske emirater drepte fire familiemedlemmer, inkludert en gravid tenåring. USA og De forente arabiske emirater utførte også luftangrep mot al-Shabaab i Nord-Somalia. 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
